Wearable temporal coverage

One cell is one participant-variable day (UTC). Colour shows observed five-minute buckets / 288, regardless of observations per bucket. Subjects use anonymous labels shared across panels. sleep and sleeprate are excluded.

White = no recorded buckets inside the subject’s first-to-last wearable date; grey background = outside that inferred window; black = a recorded row with an unavailable profile. The inferred window is not an enrolment or confirmed wear period. Missing source-days inside it are shown as zero recorded coverage. Profiles are counted once using the mean row, not summed across statistics.
